prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Pim age19 cheeky scavenger, warm brown skin #a86b4a freckles three dots each cheek, spiky near-black hair five clumps, huge cream earmuffs #e8e0d0 brass band, sticking plaster #e6c8a0 across nose two crosslines. Dot oval eyes dark with tiny catchlights, wide small grin ONE tooth gap. Oversized faded red-brown coat #7a4636 rolled thick cuffs, cornflower blue scarf #4f7fbf long tail, bulging tan leather satchel #a8835a far hip buckle spoon gear. Grey patched knee trousers and mismatched brown/grey boots. Short coat hem y254 visible legs.
Pim (the scavenger, see CHARACTERS.md). Sitting cross-legged on the ground facing right, a wooden bowl of mushrooms in the far hand. Frame 1: spoon in the bowl. Frame 2: spoon lifted halfway. Frame 3: spoon at the mouth, cheeks round. Same body in every frame, only the near arm, spoon and face change.
The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Reference is the turnaround. True transparent background. Mittens, no fingers. EXACTLY 3 complete matching frames evenly spaced in ONE horizontal row, large empty gaps between figures, identical scale every frame. Feet/body share one horizontal ground baseline. No floor, ground, cast shadow, mist, text or decoration.
